title: Prohibition Themed Downtown Atlanta Progressive Dinner
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
No one under the age of 21 is allowed on this experience since we enter a bar. Please do not bring young children, toddlers, or babies.
policies: There is a required dress code in place for this tour. For more information, please call the tour operator directly.
If you have dietary requirements, please indicate them when booking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Prohibition Progressive Dinner gets you exclusive access to the best joints in Downtown Atlanta. You won’t want to miss getting a peek at the real Coca-Cola vault and experiencing the city’s stunning skyline from a rotating rooftop, while trying sumptuous cuisine and drinks from the city’s acclaimed chefs.

During this 3 hour gourmet Atlanta food and cocktail dinner, our fun and friendly character guide coming to you from the roaring ’20s will regale you with tales of how Atlanta kept the party going throughout the Prohibition era. You’ll take a short stroll through Downtown, home to some of Atlanta’s most happening (and hidden) destinations. You’ll enjoy 9 hearty tastings and 3 swanky full-size cocktails from 4 restaurants, with an all-inclusive ticket price with service fee and gratuity included.

You won’t want to miss this exceptional evening, with plenty of food and drinks and numerous special touches to make you feel like the cat’s pajamas.
